_meta.purpose: Operational grounding for design-second-brain key terms. The house Ontology Floor's resolve() correctly misses these (design-doctrine terms, not hard/rare physical formalisms — see GROUNDING_REPORT.md). Per fail-closed doctrine they are grounded HERE, operationally: each term carries a checkable definition, a measurement method, and pass/fail thresholds. Terms with genuine math carry the formula + standard reference, marked skill-local.

terms.definition: The above-the-fold hero as a designed set-piece: cinematic at first paint, real motion starting on view, bespoke composition (never headline + stock image).
terms.measurement: First-paint screenshot review + motion audit: motion present on view, starts within 1 frame budget of intersection, has a defined end state.
terms.ontology_floor_status: ratified by the user 2026-09-12 (the approver: 'Approve, consider ratified'); verified doctrine per protocols/CINEMATIC_HERO_RULE.md (status: ratified)

terms.definition: The per-frame time envelope animation work must fit: 60fps => 16.67ms/frame. Animation JS + style/layout/paint per frame must stay under budget on target devices; prefers-reduced-motion disables non-essential motion.
terms.formula_reference: W3C requestAnimationFrame timing model; web.dev rendering performance guidance
terms.measurement: Chrome DevTools Performance trace or Lighthouse; field check via INP/LCP.

terms.definition: Rule for raster icons: ship SVG (vector, infinitely scalable) where possible; where raster is required, ship at integer multiples of the display size (1x/2x/3x) matched to devicePixelRatio, never fractional upscale of a single asset.
terms.formula: required_px = css_px * devicePixelRatio; scale factor must be integer (1, 2, 3)
terms.measurement: Asset audit: format + intrinsic px vs displayed px x devicePixelRatio.

terms.definition: WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance contrast ratio between text and background.
terms.formula: CR = (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05); L = 0.2126*R + 0.7152*G + 0.0722*B after sRGB gamma linearization
terms.measurement: Computed per WCAG 2.1 §1.4.3/§1.4.6 over final rendered colors (not design-tool swatches).

terms.definition: House brand motif: metallic gold accent treatment (gradient/texture, never flat mustard) used sparingly at focal points — hero accents, seals, rules. Black Dragons campaign: GOLD is a manifesto color alongside BLACK and RED.
terms.measurement: Design review against brand: gold reads metallic/luminous, not flat; usage is focal, not flood.
terms.ontology_floor_status: miss — aesthetic doctrine term; checkable via design review, not computable

terms.definition: Perpetual, purposeless animation (rotating gradients, floating blobs on infinite loop). BANNED except honest progress indicators visible only while a real request is in flight.
terms.measurement: Code + runtime audit: every animation has a trigger, a purpose, and an end.
terms.ontology_floor_status: miss — doctrine term; checkable via audit

terms.definition: Progress UI bound to a real in-flight request (e.g. 2.4s/cycle sweep during form POST); static under prefers-reduced-motion.
terms.measurement: Network + UI trace: indicator visible only while request is in flight; no fake staged progress.
terms.ontology_floor_status: miss — doctrine term; checkable via trace

terms.definition: Three.js (or any 3D/animation library) shipped from the repo's own vendor directory, never a CDN script tag. WebGL focal, WebGPU progressive, layers capability-gated and disposable.
terms.measurement: HTML audit: zero third-party script tags for 3D/animation libs; vendor dir present in repo.
terms.ontology_floor_status: miss — doctrine term; checkable via audit

terms.definition: Composition with deliberate asymmetry and varied rhythm — never a uniform square template grid. Current best is the floor.
terms.measurement: Design review: layout exhibits intentional asymmetry, varied section rhythm, custom composition per page.
terms.ontology_floor_status: miss — aesthetic doctrine term; checkable via review

terms.definition: Cloudflare Turnstile client token submitted with a form; server-side Siteverify fails closed (missing/invalid/network-failed => 4xx). Augments the house form protocol, never replaces origin lock / honeypot / rate limiting.
terms.measurement: E2E form submit with valid token succeeds; missing/invalid token rejected server-side with 4xx.
terms.ontology_floor_status: miss — protocol term; checkable via E2E test

terms.definition: Intake Worker accepts submissions only from registered house origins (Origin/Referer allowlist); everything else rejected.
terms.measurement: Cross-origin POST rejected; same-origin POST accepted.
terms.ontology_floor_status: miss — protocol term; checkable via test

terms.definition: Invisible form field humans never fill; any submission with it filled is rejected as bot traffic. First check in the intake pipeline, before Turnstile verify.
terms.measurement: Submission with honeypot filled => rejected; pipeline order: honeypot first.
terms.ontology_floor_status: miss — protocol term; checkable via test
